trigger: A newly accepted voice send waits for preflight before emitting send_start.
impact: Without an early heartbeat, reconnecting clients can show idle while the send is already reserved.
reproduced: Both completion and failure cases failed: no running event before send_start.
fix: Mark the accepted send active immediately and retire it in finally; terminal events continue to retire the heartbeat before background cleanup.
verification: Identical tests passed on the first repair check; review loop verified. All seven focused transport and admission tests passed.
